title: Emergence ladder x aspects

vertical.name: emergence floor
vertical.meaning: E0 physics -> E4 chemistry -> E6 organisms -> E8 individual minds -> E9 attention/memes -> E10 institutions -> E11 economy -> E12 states -> E13 epistemes -> E14 civilizational. E8/E9 is the hinge between minds and coordination.

level_note: Each assignment carries a level: 0 models the world, 1 models the instance's own models, 2 models the modelling process. Consolidation runs bottom-up and never compresses what a live higher level reads.

criteria: operability: blind coders place a new model at kappa >= 0.5
discrimination: cards spread across cells rather than clumping
joint-carving: map-adjacent models share attribution cross-hits more than distant ones
gap fertility: named gaps provoke models; inert gaps count against
adequacy.graded: none yet - the incumbent holds by default, not by evidence

succession_rule: A challenger projection is ADDED alongside, never edited in. Beat the incumbent on >=2 adequacy criteria over the same cards and default rendering switches. Retired projections are kept so historical cards stay interpretable.
note: Starter projection: axes only, no assignments. The mapping model is itself a model — versioned, adequacy-graded, replaceable.
